snippet.title: Geometry Wars Retro Evolved 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a collection of HD video that was available during the early days of the Xbox 360 to download from Xbox Live. 

Some of this content such as the E3 coverage was only available for a very limited time. High definition content was pretty scarce on the internet back in the 2000's. Even YouTube only supported very badly compressed SD flash video for many years.

For more information on this archive and other rare Xbox 360 content please visit Digiex: https://digiex.net/threads/xbox-video-archive-view-and-download-old-xbox-videos.15348/
